test_title: PYST 49: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'MAPS' is written as '49' and 'SOLD' is written as '50'. How will ' KIDS' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Sum of the position values according to the English alphabetic series is written.

So,

 
• 'MAPS' is written as '49'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e34d6bb5b363b46c206b1197cef57c7544b7094cee98fd10550f6f10bdfaa18.png] 

And,

 
• 'SOLD' is written as '50'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c19f8defd022f638beff08bbd0c889f992d5c5e30173ea880e75752df5aefbf9.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'KIDS' will be written as :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c07517b5f4730ceff8e1eb18b3c06b9fbc309a98d4dbb1ff980554820a93949.png] 

​Hence, "43" is the correct answer.
